title: 第1144章 册封皇夫女帝献吻第1143章 女帝的腿怎么在抖
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
另一边，食府雅间。
厉归天正与一众白虎卫推杯换盏。
仙酿入喉，豪气上涌，一名壮硕白虎将领忍不住问道。
“大哥，你说女帝陛下突然急召殿下入宫，是要干嘛？”
厉归天端着酒盏，理所当然道。
“还能干嘛？”
“墨兄乃陛下义子，自然是指点修行。”
说着，他神色一肃，压低嗓音。
“对了，你们没把墨兄的身份说出去吧？”
那壮汉连忙摇头。
“老祖都发话了，我们哪敢乱说？”
“不过我就是想不明白，既是女帝义子，为何要隐藏身份？”
厉归天露出一副看透一切的表情，冷笑一声。
“这还不简单？”
“历练！”
“陛下定是怕女帝义子这个身份太过安逸，让殿下失去进取之心，所以才故意隐而不宣。”
“我敢说，陛下绝对是将墨兄当作下一任帝王来培养的。”
他端起酒碗猛灌一口，眼底闪过一丝狂热。
等殿下成了新君，自己修为估计也能长进不少，与陛下一个境界。
到时候，自己就能光明正大地……

几名将士听完厉归天的分析，觉得极有道理，连连点头赞同。
就在这时，刺目的金光冲破窗棂，照亮了整个雅间。
天空之上，雄浑的天威震荡而下。
“天降神辉！是女帝颁诏！”
厉归天猛地站起身，神色骤肃。
“快！随我出去一探究竟！”
一行人火速冲出食府。
长街之上，无数妖族修士也皆被这天地异象惊动，纷纷涌上街头，仰头望天。
但见九霄云外，金芒万丈，瑞彩千条。
隐约可见三道威仪万千、宛若神明般的人影伫立云端。
下一瞬，厉羲和那清冷、威严的嗓音，响彻天地，传遍每一个角落。
“堃沦诸民、朝野众卿，听朕谕令。”
“朕厉羲和，居堃沦帝位百万载，掌山河、定秩序，独揽万里乾坤，从无半分软肋。”
“然世间万般锦绣荣华，终不及身畔一人相伴。”
“今朕降拔天诏，昭告堃沦！”
“墨羽，乃朕此生唯一心悦之人。”
“朕今日亲下帝谕，册封墨羽为堃沦皇夫，与朕共治江山，同登帝座。”
“往后朝野文武、堃沦众生，见皇夫如见朕。”
“其礼遇规制，皆与朕平齐，尊卑同君，无有高下。”
content_en:
On the other side, there is an elegant restaurant.
Li Guitian was exchanging cups with a group of White Tiger Guards.
Immortal brew entered his throat, and his heroic spirit surged up. A strong white tiger general couldn't help but ask.
"Brother, what do you mean by the sudden summons to the palace by Her Majesty the Empress?"
Li Guitian held the wine cup and said matter-of-factly.
"What else can you do?"
"Brother Mo is His Majesty's adopted son, so he will naturally give you guidance in practice."
As he spoke, he looked solemn and lowered his voice.
"By the way, you didn't reveal Brother Mo's identity, did you?"
The strong man shook his head quickly.
"The ancestor has already spoken, how dare we speak nonsense?"
"But I just don't understand. Since he is the adopted son of the Empress, why should he hide his identity?"
Li Guitian showed a look that saw everything and sneered.
"Isn't this simple?"
"Experience!"
"Your Majesty must be afraid that the status of the adopted son of the Empress will be too comfortable, which will make His Highness lose his ambition, so he deliberately kept it secret."
"I dare say that His Majesty is definitely training Brother Mo as the next emperor."
He picked up the wine bowl and took a swig, a hint of fanaticism flashing in his eyes.
When Your Highness becomes the new king, I will probably improve a lot in my own cultivation and be on the same level as His Majesty.
At that time, I will be able to act openly and honestly...
After listening to Li Guitian's analysis, several soldiers felt that it was very reasonable and nodded in agreement.
At this moment, the dazzling golden light broke through the window lattice and illuminated the entire private room.
Above the sky, the majestic power of heaven shook down.
"God's glory comes from heaven! It's the empress who issued the edict!"
Li Guitian stood up suddenly, his expression suddenly solemn.
"Quick! Follow me out to find out!"
The group of people rushed out of the restaurant.
On the long street, countless demon monks were also alarmed by the strange phenomenon of heaven and earth. They rushed to the street one after another and looked up at the sky.
But outside the clouds in the sky, there are thousands of golden lights and thousands of auspicious colors.
Three majestic, god-like figures can be vaguely seen standing in the clouds.
The next moment, Li Xihe's cold, majestic voice resounded throughout the world and spread to every corner.
"All the people of Kunlun, and all the ministers of the court and the public, listen to my orders."
"I, Li Xihe, have been in the position of Kunlun Emperor for millions of years. I have controlled the mountains and rivers, established order, and monopolized the world for thousands of miles. I have never had any weaknesses."
"However, all the beauty and splendor in the world is ultimately inferior to having one person by your side."
"Today I issue an imperial edict from Heaven to warn Kunlun!"
"Mo Yu is the only person I like in my life."
"Today I personally issued an imperial edict to confer Mo Yu as the husband of the Kunlun Emperor. He will rule the country with me and ascend to the throne of the emperor together."
"From now on, civil and military officials and civilians in both the government and the public, as well as all living beings, will treat the emperor as if they were seeing me."
"The courtesy and regulations are all on the same level as mine. I am the same as you in respect and inferiority. There is no superiority or inferiority."
